62	def _fewer_tokens(tokens, remove):
63	    '''Process the output of `tokenize.generate_tokens` removing
64	    the tokens specified in `remove`.
65	    '''
66	    for values in tokens:
67	        if values[0] in remove:
68	            continue
69	        yield values

72	def _find(tokens, token, value):
73	    '''Return the position of the last token with the same (token, value)
74	    pair supplied. The position is the one of the rightmost term.
75	    '''
76	    for index, token_values in enumerate(reversed(tokens)):
77	        if (token, value) == token_values[:2]:
78	            return len(tokens) - index - 1
79	    raise ValueError('(token, value) pair not found')
80

82	def _split_tokens(tokens, token, value):
83	    '''Split a list of tokens on the specified token pair (token, value),
84	    where *token* is the token type (i.e. its code) and *value* its actual
85	    value in the code.
86	    '''
87	    res = [[]]
88	    for token_values in tokens:
89	        if (token, value) == token_values[:2]:
90	            res.append([])
91	            continue
92	        res[-1].append(token_values)
93	    return res
